strings.Au moins 1, sans limite haute. Par défau: At least 1, no upper limit. Default 1000 (500 on a Raspberry Pi Zero). The longer the history, the slower the "Aircraft seen" page is to load (especially on a Raspberry Pi), the bigger the file (about 360 KB for 1000 aircraft, re-read and rewritten by the program) and the more the SD card is used. The oldest aircraft are deleted when the limit is exceeded.
strings.Au moins 1, sans limite haute. Valeur co: At least 1, no upper limit. Recommended and default value on this Raspberry Pi Zero: 500. Beyond it, the "Aircraft seen" page becomes very slow to load (each extra aircraft lengthens the page), the history file grows (about 360 KB for 1000 aircraft, re-read and rewritten by the program) and the SD card is used more. The oldest aircraft are deleted when the limit is exceeded.
strings.Nombre d'avions gardés dans la page « Av: Number of aircraft kept in the "Aircraft seen" page: beyond it, the oldest are deleted. A longer history slows the page and weighs on the SD card: the default is 1000 aircraft, and 500 on a Raspberry Pi Zero, but you can choose any value you want. The change requires restarting the program.
strings.De 50 à 5000. Les avions les plus ancien: From 50 to 5000. The oldest aircraft are deleted when the limit is exceeded.
strings.De 50 à 500 : un Raspberry Pi Zero est l: From 50 to 500: a Raspberry Pi Zero is limited to 500 aircraft (memory, SD card and slow web page). The oldest aircraft are deleted when the limit is exceeded.
strings.Nombre d'avions gardés dans la page « Av: Number of aircraft kept in the "Aircraft seen" page: beyond it, the oldest are deleted. A longer history slows the page and weighs on the SD card; on a Raspberry Pi Zero it is limited to 500 aircraft. The change requires restarting the program.

strings.adsb.lol et adsb.fi sont des services co: adsb.lol and adsb.fi are free community services, with no key, that broadcast aircraft picked up by thousands of ADS-B antennas, MLAT positions included. The program asks them for the aircraft inside a circle around your position that covers the whole screen. They give no precise model, airline or route: these are then requested from adsbdb.com (option "Complete aircraft missing from Flightradar24", in "Aircraft sources"). Non-commercial use. These sources are enabled and ranked in "Aircraft sources".
strings.Commun aux trois services. Ne descendez: Shared by the three services. Do not go below 1 s: they limit the number of requests.
strings.Service communautaire gratuit : les avio: Free community service: aircraft picked up by thousands of antennas, MLAT included.
strings.Position calculée par multilatération (M: Position computed by multilateration (MLAT) by the source
strings.position invalide : renseignez la latitu: invalid position: enter the latitude and longitude in "Map and position"
strings.ce n'est pas un fichier aircraft.json (p: this is not an aircraft.json file (no "aircraft" or "ac" list)
strings.Flightradar24 fournit les positions mond: Flightradar24 provides worldwide positions over the Internet, as well as each aircraft's registration, model, airline, route and photo. Positions are refreshed about every 30 s; too short an interval causes 429 errors. This source is enabled and ranked in "Aircraft sources".
strings.Serveur tar1090 (https://github.com/wied: tar1090 server (https://github.com/wiedehopf/tar1090) on your network, fed by an ADS-B antenna and read through its aircraft.json file. Near-instant positions, no quota and no Internet. It only sees aircraft picked up by the antenna and gives no model, airline or route: these are then requested from adsbdb.com (option "Complete aircraft picked up only by the antenna", in "Aircraft sources"). This source is enabled and ranked in "Aircraft sources".
strings.Positions mondiales par Internet, avec d: Worldwide positions over the Internet, with details and a photo of each aircraft.
strings.Votre antenne ADS-B locale : positions q: Your local ADS-B antenna: near-instant positions, no Internet.
strings.Donne à cette source la priorité sur cel: Gives this source priority over the one above
strings.Les icônes prennent une couleur selon la: Icons take a colour according to the source or sources that see the aircraft (the aircraft shown in the photo panel keeps its usual colour).
strings.D'où viennent les avions affichés. Coche: Where the displayed aircraft come from. Tick one or more sources, rank them by priority and choose how to combine their results. An aircraft recognised by several sources is never shown twice. Changes require restarting the program.
strings.Un avion absent de Flightradar24 n'a que: An aircraft missing from Flightradar24 only has its position: its registration, model, airline, route and a photo are then requested from adsbdb.com (free service, no key). The same applies to an aircraft that Flightradar24 knows but gives no photo for. The aircraft's ICAO address and callsign are sent to that service. Untick to stay fully local: the aircraft is then shown without details.
strings.Pour tar1090 : http://adresse/tar1090/da: For tar1090: http://address/tar1090/data/aircraft.json. Standalone dump1090-fa or readsb installs work too (http://address/dump1090-fa/data/aircraft.json).

strings.Le fichier ne donne ni immatriculation n: The file gives neither registration nor type: they will be looked up on adsbdb.com.
strings.Aucune source cochée : Flightradar24 ser: No source ticked: Flightradar24 will be used.
strings.Une seule source est active : les option: Only one source is active: the combination options below do not apply until a second one is ticked.
strings.Tous les avions de toutes les sources so: All aircraft from all sources are shown, each only once. The most complete: an aircraft picked up by only one source still appears.
strings.Seule la source n°1 décide quels avions: Only source no. 1 decides which aircraft are shown and where. The others only complete missing information (registration, type, route). If source no. 1 stops responding, the next one becomes the main source.
strings.Une seule source à la fois : la n°1. Si: One source at a time: no. 1. If it stops responding, no. 2 takes over, and no. 1 resumes as soon as it is back. The simplest: no data is mixed.
strings.Si un avion est vu par plusieurs sources: If an aircraft is seen by several sources
strings.Pour chaque avion, on garde la position,: For each aircraft, the position, speed and heading come from the source whose last message is the most recent. Recommended: the local antenna, read every 2 s, almost always beats Flightradar24 (30 s) and the aircraft moves more smoothly.
strings.L'avion garde les valeurs de la source c: The aircraft keeps the values of the source ranked highest in the list, even if another is more recent. Choose it if you trust one source more for positions; the other then only brings the aircraft the first does not see.
strings.Un même avion est reconnu d'une source à: The same aircraft is recognised from one source to another by its ICAO address (the hexadecimal code of its transponder): it is never counted or shown twice (map, alert, history, MQTT).
strings.Position, vitesse, altitude et cap vienn: Position, speed, altitude and heading always come from a single source per aircraft: they are never mixed or averaged.
strings.Les informations manquantes sont complét: Missing information is completed by the other sources (registration, type, callsign, route), whatever the mode.
strings.Une source qui ne répond plus est ignoré: A source that stops responding is ignored after a few seconds (it stays flagged here); the others carry on.
strings.Exemple : que devient un avion selon le: Example: what happens to an aircraft depending on the mode?
strings.Avion vu par les deux sources (n°1 : pos: Aircraft seen by both sources (no. 1: position from 8 s ago, no. 2: 1 s ago)
strings.Avion vu par la source n°2 seulement: Aircraft seen by source no. 2 only
strings.Position de la source n°2 (la plus récen: Position from source no. 2 (the most recent)
strings.Ignoré (tant que la source n°1 répond): Ignored (as long as source no. 1 responds)
strings.Redémarrage du Pi ou coupure du réseau ?: Is the Pi restarting or the network down? The page reconnects by itself and returns to where you were.

Each cleanup is written in the log of this page. When enabled, the program no longer deletes photos older than 3 days at startup.

strings.Les avions en direct apparaissent dès qu: Live aircraft appear as soon as the display program is running.
strings.La carte n'a pas pu être chargée (accès: The map could not be loaded (this browser needs internet access). You can still type the values in the fields below.
strings.pygame (LGPL), requests (Apache 2.0), Pi: pygame (LGPL), requests (Apache 2.0), Pillow (MIT-CMU), paho-mqtt (EPL 2.0 or BSD 3-Clause), DejaVu fonts. In webadmin: Leaflet (BSD 2-Clause), for the position picker map.
strings.Personnalisez le fond de carte : thème,: Customize the base map: theme, displayed elements, colors and place names. Choosing a theme shows a sample map right away (indicative); "Refresh the preview" gives the faithful rendering of your area, with your colors and elements. Then save and rebuild the map so that the screen uses it.
strings.Par défaut, les couleurs du thème choisi: By default, the colors of the chosen theme. A color changed here replaces the theme's; choosing another theme resets them.
strings.Les noms de lieux, les routes et les aut: Place names, roads and the other elements come from the CARTO vector base map. On a light background, yellow aircraft stand out less: prefer a dark theme for a display readable from afar.
strings.L'aperçu n'a pas pu être généré :: The preview could not be generated:
strings.L'aperçu a pris trop de temps (réseau le: The preview took too long (slow network?).
strings.La clé API CARTO n'est pas renseignée (C: The CARTO API key is not set (Map and position, Base map): the preview needs it.
strings.une construction de la carte ou une mise: a map build or an update is in progress
strings.un aperçu est déjà en cours de génératio: a preview is already being generated
strings.L'avion dont la photo est montrée dans l: The aircraft whose photo is shown in the panel.
strings.Types absents de la liste (voir Types d': Types missing from the list (see Aircraft types).
strings.Les réglages ont changé : l'aperçu affic: Settings have changed: the displayed preview is out of date.
strings.Cliquez sur la carte ou faites glisser l: Click the map or drag the marker to set your position. The yellow rectangle is the area the program will display; the gray circles are the distance circles. The values are written in the fields below; then save and rebuild the map.
strings.Cercles centrés sur votre position, trac: Circles centered on your position, drawn by the program (no need to rebuild the map).
strings.Seuls les cercles contenus dans la haute: Only circles that fit within the map height are drawn.
strings.Peut aussi servir de distance d'alerte (: Can also be used as the alert distance (Proximity alert).
strings.Afficher la distance sur chaque cercle: Show the distance on each circle
strings.Petit texte « 5 km » au sommet du cercle: Small "5 km" text at the top of the circle.
strings.Utiliser la distance du premier cercle: Use the distance of the first circle
strings.Le rayon d'alerte prend la distance du p: The alert radius takes the distance of the first circle (Map and position, Distance circles). Turn off to set another distance.
strings.0 désactive toute l'alerte. Ignoré quand: 0 turns the whole alert off. Ignored when the distance of the first circle is used (option below, offered only when at least one circle is displayed).
strings.Cette version n'est pas une version de s: This version is not a fallback version.
